description: Main source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game, including UI components, theme configuration, and game logic.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring theme and routing for the Tic Tac Toe Flutter app.

classes.name: TicTacToePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main game screen with game logic and UI.

classes.name: _StatusBadge
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying game status messages with styled background.

classes.name: _TicTacToeCell
classes.description: Stateful widget representing individual game board cells with hover and tap effects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, runs the TicTacToeApp.

methods.name: TicTacToeApp
methods.description: Constructor for the root app widget, sets up theme and home page.

methods.name: _oceanScheme
methods.description: Generates a color scheme based on brightness for the Ocean Professional theme.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Creates ThemeData based on the provided brightness and custom color scheme.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the MaterialApp with theme, darkTheme, and initial home widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the TicTacToePage widget.

methods.name: handleTap
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a cell; updates game state and checks for winner.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks all win conditions and returns the winning mark ('X' or 'O') or null.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets game state to start a new game.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the game UI, including game board, status badge, and control buttons.
